CDC began a multistate outbreak investigation to determine the source of the infections

methods_quotes.q: Investigators sought to match each case-patient with two controls.
Controls were persons with recent infection of Salmonella strains other than the outbreak strain and matched to case-patients by age and county of residence.
Exposure histories were collected for 7 days before illness onset for case-patients and for 7 days before interview for controls.
